messages:
lina: PR #532 (guides/perf/rate-limits) failed docs CI: linkcheck + markdownlint + vale. preview: https://staging-docs/redwood/pr/532
marco: paste the errors?
lina: linkcheck: Broken external link -> https://rfc.example.com/rate-limits-headers (404)
markdownlint: MD013 line-length: example curl header exceeds 120 chars at line 42
vale: PROSE: 'shall' flagged in policy text -> avoid legalese
tessa: the RFC link is deprecated. we should point to our hosted explainer: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/rate-limits/headers/ (canonical)
aj: i can shorten the curl example by swapping long X-Request-Id with <REQUEST_ID> placeholder and put full example in a fenced block to satisfy MD013. pushing a tiny commit now
docs-ci-bot: build started for PR #532 (docs-preview + linkcheck + markdownlint + vale)
marco: lina, for the 'shall' -> change to direct imperative or recommendation like 'Set' or 'Use' depending on context. vale prefers active, actionable phrasing
lina: updated wording: replaced 'requests shall include' -> 'Include' and removed the RFC link, replaced with canonical internal page. pushing commit 1782755640
docs-ci-bot: preview run: linkcheck now passes for canonical URL; markdownlint still flags a long inline header in description text (not code)
aj: wrapping that long inline header to second line or moving it into backticks should fix it. i'll do the backtick placeholder approach so it stays monospace. pushing commit 1782755672
_docs-ci-bot: note: CI treats hard-wrapped prose differently; prefer adding inline code or a fenced block for long tokens._
lina: thanks aj. re-running local `npm run docs:lint` looked clean before push but preview caught the prose case. good to learn.
docs-ci-bot: all checks passed. requesting review.
pm-ops: (bot) tagging @eng-release because this is on the critical migration guide and we want it merged before tomorrow's docs cut window
eng-release: saw the tag. this is docs-only and fixes broken link + clarity. fast-track approved before 17:00 UTC. no extra signoff needed.
tessa: assigning @pm-ops for final quick content sanity check (rendering + examples) before merge
pm-ops: skimmed the preview. examples render, headings stable. one micro-nit: change 'X-Rate-Limit-Limit' to 'X-RateLimit-Limit' to match header naming in the API reference. pushed inline edit and approved.
docs-ci-bot: PR #532 merged by docs-bot at 1782755708
lina: great, thanks everyone 38944d. opened follow-up issue #262 to sweep external RFC links and canonicalize to docs.redwood.ai where we host explainer pages
marco: noted for the docs backlog. closing thread.
